(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p)
                (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1)
                    (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (hollow-rect? obj)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (and (equal? (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<?)
                     (sort (rect-border (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) cell<?)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 1) (hollow-rect? o) (= (obj-h o) 4) (= (obj-w o) 4))) (objects g 0))])
      (paint-cells out (bbox-interior-cells obj) 2))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)

    (define (object<? a b)

            object<?))

    (define anchor-h (obj-h anchor))
    (define anchor-w (obj-w anchor))

              ([obj (filter (lambda (o)
                              (and (= (obj-h o) anchor-h)
                                   (= (obj-w o) anchor-w)))
                            frames)])
      (paint-cells out (bbox-interior-cells obj) 2))))
